title: Make judgment reusable: help your business learn from AI work
seoTitle: Make Judgment Reusable: Better AI Workflows for Business Owners
subtitle: Keep the reasoning behind the review
description: Turn recurring AI corrections into clear standards, examples and decisions. A practical approach for CEOs who want the business to learn from reviewed work.
deck: When your team corrects AI work, preserve the decision behind the edit. Give the next person and the next workflow a better place to begin.
imageAlt: Make judgment reusable. Keep the reasoning behind the review. Roman Bediner.
toc: Keep the reason behind the edit
Keep room for a new answer

reusable-judgment.label: Proposed learning loop: current standards inform preparation, review checks evidence and a named owner accepts or returns the work. The owner records scoped decisions in shared standards, so future preparation and review use them. Exceptions require a fresh decision.
reusable-judgment.caption: A proposed operating loop, not a measured result. Keep a decision's reason, scope and owner. Verify that the next different case actually uses it.
reusable-judgment.eyebrow: LET THE BUSINESS RETAIN THE LEARNING
